subject: Copywriting
title: The First Marketing Email
description: A short lesson to help you apply The First Marketing Email.

hook.text: In 1978, Gary Thuerk sent one email to 400 people on ARPANET. It sold $13 million in computers. Also created spam.

buildup.text: Thuerk worked for Digital Equipment Corporation. His mass email pitched new computers to ARPANET users directly.

discovery.text: The response was explosive: orders poured in. But so did complaints. The Defense Department threatened to ban him.

twist.text: That single email had a 3,250% ROI. Modern email marketing averages $36 per $1 spent. Thuerk discovered a goldmine.

climax.text: One email created an industry worth $11 billion today.

punchline.text: $13 million from one email. Email marketing was born in 1978.

quiz.question: How much did the first marketing email generate in sales?
